sections.title: Lead-in — the weather and the seasons

exercises.instructionEn: In which card is the weather ...?
exercises.instructionUz: Qaysi kartada ob-havo ... ?
exercises.explanationUz:
UNIT MAVZUSI — OB-HAVO.

Sarlavha: 'Come Rain or Shine'
  so'zma-so'z: yomg'ir yog'sa ham, quyosh chiqsa ham
  ma'nosi: har qanday sharoitda, nima bo'lsa ham
  o'zbekchada: 'Qanday bo'lmasin', 'Har holatda ham'

TO'RT KARTA:
  A — gullagan daraxt, pushti ko'ylakdagi ayol, yigit gul uzyapti
  B — qor, yalang'och daraxtlar, qorbo'ron o'ynayotgan bolalar
  C — plyaj, katta to'q sariq soyabon, cho'milish kiyimidagi odam
  D — kuchli shamol, yalang'och daraxtlar, ko'l bo'yida ketayotgan
      paltodagi odamlar

OB-HAVO SIFATLARI:
  cold ......... sovuq
  cloudy ....... bulutli
  windy ........ shamolli
  freezing cold  qattiq sovuq (muzlatadigan)
  snowy ........ qorli
  hot .......... issiq
  sunny ........ quyoshli
  warm ......... iliq

tasks.whyUz:
D kartada daraxtlar shamoldan egilgan, odamlar shlyapasini ushlab turibdi.
Osmon bulutli va kulrang — kuz ob-havosi.

B kartada hamma yer qor bilan qoplangan, bolalar qorbo'ron o'ynayapti.
'freezing' = muzlatadigan — 'very cold' dan kuchliroq.

C kartada plyaj, quyoshdan saqlanish uchun katta soyabon,
odamlar cho'milish kiyimida — demak JUDA ISSIQ.

A kartada daraxtlar gullagan, o't yashil, osmon ochiq.
Issiq emas — ILIQ (bahor).

exercises.instructionEn: Label the cards with the names of the seasons: summer, winter, spring or autumn.
exercises.instructionUz: Kartalarni fasl nomlari bilan belgilang: summer, winter, spring yoki autumn.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'RT FASL:
  spring ..... bahor  (mart, aprel, may)
  summer ..... yoz    (iyun, iyul, avgust)
  autumn ..... kuz    (sentabr, oktabr, noyabr)
              amerikacha: fall
  winter ..... qish   (dekabr, yanvar, fevral)

DIQQAT — FASL OLDIDA PREDLOG:
  IN spring, IN summer, IN autumn, IN winter
  Artikl kerak emas: 'in THE spring' ham to'g'ri, lekin
  kitob artiklsiz shaklni beradi.

exercises.instructionEn: Then, ask and answer questions, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: So'ng namunadagidek savol-javob qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  S1: What's the weather like in spring?
  S2: It's warm and sunny in spring.

DIQQAT — 'What's the weather LIKE?':
  Bu ob-havo haqidagi ASOSIY savol.
  'like' bu yerda 'yoqtirmoq' EMAS — 'qanday?' degani.
  So'zma-so'z: 'Ob-havo nimaga o'xshaydi?'

JAVOB DOIM 'IT'S ...' bilan boshlanadi:
  It's warm.  It's raining.  It's cold and windy.
  DIQQAT: 'The weather is warm' ham to'g'ri, lekin
  'IT'S ...' tabiiyroq.

exercises.instructionEn: Match these sentences to the cards. Two of them do not match any of the cards.
exercises.instructionUz: Bu gaplarni kartalarga moslang. Ulardan ikkitasi hech qaysi kartaga mos kelmaydi.
exercises.explanationUz:
DIQQAT — IKKI GAP HECH QAYSI KARTAGA MOS KELMAYDI.
Kartalarda YOMG'IR ham, TUMAN ham yo'q.

OB-HAVO — IKKI XIL AYTISH USULI:

  1) FE'L bilan (hozir sodir bo'layotgan hodisa):
       It is raining.   — yomg'ir yog'yapti
       It is snowing.   — qor yog'yapti
       The sun is shining. — quyosh charaqlayapti
       The wind is blowing. — shamol esayapti

  2) SIFAT bilan ('be' + sifat):
       It's rainy.   — yomg'irli
       It's snowy.   — qorli
       It's sunny.   — quyoshli
       It's windy.   — shamolli
       It's cloudy.  — bulutli
       It's foggy.   — tumanli

Sifatlar OT + -Y qoidasi bilan yasalgan:
  rain → rainy,  snow → snowy,  sun → sunny,
  wind → windy,  cloud → cloudy,  fog → foggy

tasks.prompt: 1  There are clouds in the sky and the wind is blowing. It's cloudy and windy.
tasks.promptUz: Shamolda egilgan daraxtlar bor kartani toping
tasks.whyUz:
D kartada daraxtlar shamoldan egilgan va osmon bulutli.
'a cloud' = bulut; 'to blow' = esmoq.
tasks.speak: 1  There are clouds in the sky and the wind is blowing. It's cloudy and windy.

tasks.prompt: 2  The sun is shining. It's sunny.
tasks.whyUz:
A karta (bahor) ham, C karta (yoz) ham quyoshli.
Ikkalasi ham to'g'ri javob.
'to shine' = charaqlamoq, porlamoq.
tasks.speak: 2  The sun is shining. It's sunny.

tasks.prompt: 3  It is raining. It's a rainy day.
tasks.whyUz:
HECH QAYSI kartaga mos kelmaydi — birortasida ham yomg'ir yo'q.
Bu — kitob aytgan ikki gapdan biri.
tasks.speak: 3  It is raining. It's a rainy day.

tasks.prompt: 4  It is snowing. It's a snowy day.
tasks.whyUz: B kartada hamma yer qor bilan qoplangan.
tasks.speak: 4  It is snowing. It's a snowy day.

tasks.prompt: 5  There is a lot of fog. It's foggy.
tasks.whyUz:
HECH QAYSI kartaga mos kelmaydi — birortasida ham tuman yo'q.
'fog' = tuman (sanalmaydigan ot).
Bu — kitob aytgan ikki gapdan ikkinchisi.
tasks.speak: 5  There is a lot of fog. It's foggy.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the cards. Which card shows someone who is wearing: 1 a red coat? 2 gloves? 3 boots? 4 a pink dress? 5 a heavy jacket? 6 a blue hat? 7 a swimming-costume? 8 a jacket and a red tie? 9 a black cap?
exercises.instructionUz: Kartalarga qarang. Qaysi kartada kimdir quyidagini kiygan: 1 qizil palto? 2 qo'lqop? 3 etik? 4 pushti ko'ylak? 5 qalin kurtka? 6 ko'k shlyapa? 7 cho'milish kiyimi? 8 pidjak va qizil galstuk? 9 qora kepka?
exercises.explanationUz:
KIYIM SO'ZLARI:
  a coat ............. palto
  gloves ............. qo'lqoplar (doim ko'plikda)
  boots .............. etiklar (doim ko'plikda)
  a dress ............ ko'ylak (ayollar uchun)
  a jacket ........... kurtka, pidjak
  a hat .............. shlyapa
  a swimming-costume . cho'milish kiyimi
  a tie .............. galstuk
  a cap .............. kepka (kozirekli bosh kiyim)

DIQQAT — 'to wear' fe'li:
  Hozir kiyib turgan bo'lsa: someone IS WEARING ...
  'to wear' = kiyib yurmoq (holat)
  'to put on' = kiyib olmoq (harakat)

tasks.whyUz:
B kartada chapdagi kichkina qiz QIZIL palto kiygan.
DIQQAT: D kartadagi ayolning paltosi PUSHTI (pink), qizil emas.

B kartadagi qizning qo'lida oq qo'lqop bor.
'gloves' DOIM ko'plikda — ikkita qo'l uchun.

B kartadagi katta bolada qizil bog'ichli etiklar bor.
DIQQAT: A kartada ham etik bor, lekin B da qish etiklari aniqroq ko'rinadi.

A kartadagi ayol uzun PUSHTI ko'ylak kiygan.
'a dress' — faqat ayollar kiyimi.

D kartadagi yigit qalin, mo'ynali qora kurtka kiygan.
'heavy' bu yerda = qalin, issiq (og'ir emas).
DIQQAT: B kartadagi bolaning kurtkasi ham qalin.
B kartadagi qizil paltodagi qiz KO'K shlyapa kiygan.

C kartada qumda o'tirgan odam qizil cho'milish kiyimida.
'a swimming-costume' — britancha; amerikacha 'a swimsuit'.

tasks.prompt: 8  a jacket and a red tie?
tasks.whyUz: A kartadagi yigit to'q rangli pidjak va QIZIL galstuk kiygan.
tasks.speak: 8  a jacket and a red tie?

tasks.promptUz: Shamolda bosh kiyimini ushlab turgan yigit
tasks.whyUz:
D kartadagi yigitda qora kepka bor — shamol uni uchirib yubormasin deb ushlab turibdi.
DIQQAT: A kartadagi yigitning kepkasi KATAKLI (checked), qora emas.

exercises.instructionEn: Choose words from the list to fill in the gaps, then use them to make sentences.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdan so'z tanlab bo'shliqlarni to'ldiring, so'ng ular bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: miss, keep, make, season's, heavy, decorate, enjoy

QANDAY TANLANADI:
  'to' dan keyin → FE'L (decorate, enjoy, make, keep)
  ot oldida      → SIFAT yoki EGALIK (heavy, season's)
  ega + ...      → FE'L (miss)

Barcha iboralar 49-betdagi uchta otkritkadan olingan.

tasks.whyUz:
'to decorate the Christmas tree' = archani bezamoq (B otkritka).
Gap: They are decorating the Christmas tree.

'We miss you a lot' = sizni juda sog'indik (B otkritka).
Ko'plik ega ('we') → fe'lga -s QO'SHILMAYDI.

'to enjoy the good weather' = yaxshi ob-havodan zavqlanmoq (C otkritka).
Gap: Everyone is enjoying the good weather.

'Season's greetings' = bayram tabriklari (C otkritka).
Egalik apostrofi: season + 's.

'heavy jackets' = qalin kurtkalar (A otkritka).
'heavy' bu yerda = qalin, issiq (og'ir emas).

'to make a snowman' = qorbobo yasamoq (A otkritka).
Gap: They are making a snowman in the park.

'to keep them warm' = ularni issiq saqlamoq (A otkritka).
Bu ibora 40-betdagi pingvin matnida ham bor edi.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in on, in, at, of or from.
exercises.instructionUz: on, in, at, of yoki from predloglarini qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
PREDLOGLAR — ASOSIY QOIDALAR:

  IN — ichida: shahar, bog', xona, kiyim
       in Warsaw, in the park, in their pyjamas
  ON — yuzasida: plyaj, ko'cha, devor, muz
       on the beach, on the wall
  AT — aniq nuqta yoki vaqt:
       at the moment, at 5 o'clock, at home
  FROM — kelib chiqish nuqtasi:
       Greetings from London
  OF — egalik yoki tarkib:
       Lots of love, a lot of people

DIQQAT — SHAHAR va PLYAJ:
  IN Warsaw (shahar ICHIDA)
  ON the beach (plyaj YUZASIDA)

tasks.whyUz:
Shahar, mamlakat, mahalla → IN.
'It is cold IN Warsaw.'

Bog', o'rmon, xona → IN.
'They are making a snowman IN the park.'
'AT the moment' = ayni paytda — o'zgarmas ibora.
'Greetings FROM ...' = ...dan salom. Kelib chiqish nuqtasi → FROM.

'be IN + kiyim' = kiygan holda bo'lmoq.
'The children are IN their pyjamas.'

'ON the beach' — plyaj yuzasida turibdi → ON.
DIQQAT: 'in the beach' XATO.

'Lots OF love' = katta mehr bilan.
'lots of', 'a lot of' — miqdor iboralari doim OF bilan.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at today's international weather chart. Symbols and temperature scale.
exercises.instructionUz: Bugungi xalqaro ob-havo jadvaliga qarang. Belgilar va harorat shkalasi.
exercises.explanationUz:
OB-HAVO BELGILARI (Symbols):
  bulut           = cloudy  (bulutli)
  puflab turgan bulut = windy (shamolli)
  bulut va tomchilar  = rainy (yomg'irli)
  quyosh          = sunny   (quyoshli)
  bulut va qor    = snowy   (qorli)

HARORAT SHKALASI (sovuqdan issiqqa):
  freezing cold  −5°C / 23°F   — qattiq sovuq
  cold            5°C / 41°F   — sovuq
  chilly         10°C / 50°F   — salqin (sovuqroq)
  cool           15°C / 59°F   — salqin (yoqimli)
  warm           25°C / 77°F   — iliq
  hot            30°C / 86°F   — issiq
  boiling hot    35°C / 95°F   — juda issiq

HARORAT BIRLIKLARI:
  °C = degrees Celsius   (Selsiy darajasi)
  °F = degrees Fahrenheit (Farengeyt darajasi)
  Britaniya va Yevropa °C, AQSH esa °F ishlatadi.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at today's international weather chart. Ask and answer questions, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Bugungi xalqaro ob-havo jadvaliga qarang. Namunadagidek savol-javob qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  S1: What's the weather like in Cairo today?
  S2: It's warm and sunny.
  S1: What's the temperature in Cairo today?
  S2: It's 25°C. / It's 77°F.

IKKI SAVOL:
  What's the weather LIKE ...?  → sifat bilan javob
  What's the TEMPERATURE ...?   → daraja bilan javob

JADVAL:
  Cairo     quyosh  25 / 77
  London    shamol  10 / 50
  Madrid    bulut    5 / 41
  Manila    quyosh  30 / 86
  Paris     yomg'ir  5 / 41
  Prague    qor     −5 / 23
  Rome      bulut   15 / 59
  Singapore quyosh  35 / 95

tasks.whyUz: 10°C shkalada 'chilly' ga to'g'ri keladi; belgi shamolni bildiradi.
Jadvalda: London 10 C / 50 F.
5°C shkalada 'cold'; belgi oddiy bulut → cloudy.
Jadvalda: Madrid 5 C / 41 F.
30°C shkalada 'hot'; belgi quyosh → sunny.
Jadvalda: Manila 30 C / 86 F.
5°C shkalada 'cold'; belgi yomg'ir tomchilari → rainy.
Jadvalda: Paris 5 C / 41 F — Madrid bilan bir xil harorat, lekin ob-havo boshqa.

−5°C shkalada 'freezing cold'; belgi qor → snowy.
Bu — jadvaldagi eng sovuq shahar.

Jadvalda: Prague −5 C / 23 F.
Manfiy harorat: 'minus five degrees' deb o'qiladi.
15°C shkalada 'cool'; belgi oddiy bulut → cloudy.
Jadvalda: Rome 15 C / 59 F.

35°C shkalada 'boiling hot'; belgi quyosh → sunny.
Bu — jadvaldagi eng issiq shahar.
Jadvalda: Singapore 35 C / 95 F.

exercises.instructionEn: Which of the activities in the list can you do when it is: snowy? hot and sunny? cold and rainy?
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi mashg'ulotlardan qaysilarini qorli, issiq-quyoshli yoki sovuq-yomg'irli ob-havoda qilish mumkin?
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: go to the beach, make a snowman, go on a picnic,
         watch TV, go swimming, sunbathe, read a book, ski

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  When it is snowy you can ski or make a snowman.

QOLIP: When it is + ob-havo, you can + fe'l (+ or + fe'l).

DIQQAT: 'when' — vaqt bog'lovchisi, ergash gapni boshlaydi.

UYDA QILINADIGAN ISHLAR (watch TV, read a book) har qanday
ob-havoda mumkin — ayniqsa yomon ob-havoda.

tasks.prompt: HOT AND SUNNY (issiq va quyoshli) — nima qilish mumkin?
tasks.answer: When it is hot and sunny you can go to the beach, go on a picnic, go swimming or sunbathe.

tasks.prompt: COLD AND RAINY (sovuq va yomg'irli) — nima qilish mumkin?
tasks.answer: When it is cold and rainy you can watch TV or read a book.
tasks.whyUz: Yomg'irda tashqariga chiqib bo'lmaydi — uy ichidagi mashg'ulotlar qoladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read postcard A (from Tom in Warsaw).
exercises.instructionUz: A otkritkasini o'qing (Varshavadagi Tomdan).
exercises.explanationUz:
OTKRITKA (a postcard) TUZILISHI:

  1) Murojaat:     Dear Sally,
  2) Salomlashish: A Happy New Year to all of you.
  3) Asosiy qism:  ob-havo, kiyim, mashg'ulot
  4) Yakun:        Hope to see you soon.
  5) Xayrlashuv:   Best wishes,
  6) Imzo:         Tom

MANZIL (o'ng tomonda):
  Sally Jones          — ism
  12 Swan St           — ko'cha va uy raqami
  London SW1 4GB       — shahar va pochta indeksi
  England              — mamlakat

DIQQAT: inglizcha manzil KICHIKDAN KATTAGA yoziladi
(ism → ko'cha → shahar → mamlakat).

tasks.en: Dear Sally,
tasks.note:
'Dear + ism' — xat va otkritkaning odatiy boshlanishi.
O'zbekchadagidek 'Assalomu alaykum' emas.

tasks.en: A Happy New Year to all of you.
tasks.note:
'A Happy New Year to you' — tabrik shakli.
'all of you' = hammangiz.

tasks.en: You can't imagine how cold it is in Warsaw!
tasks.uz: Varshavada qanchalik sovuq ekanini tasavvur ham qila olmaysiz!
tasks.note:
'to imagine' = tasavvur qilmoq.
'how cold it is' — bilvosita gapda tartib O'ZGARMAYDI:
'how cold IS it' XATO.

tasks.en: It is snowing heavily today, so the children are wearing their heavy jackets and gloves to keep them warm.
tasks.uz: Bugun qor qalin yog'yapti, shuning uchun bolalar issiq turish uchun qalin kurtka va qo'lqop kiyib olishgan.
tasks.note:
KIYIM HAQIDAGI GAP — 7-mashqda tagiga chiziladi.
'so' = shuning uchun (sabab-natija).
'to keep them warm' — 40-betdagi pingvin matnidagi ibora.

tasks.en: They are making a snowman in the park at the moment.
tasks.note:
'a snowman' = qorbobo (snow + man).
'at the moment' = ayni paytda — Present Continuous belgisi.

tasks.en: Hope to see you soon.
tasks.note: '(I) hope to see you soon' — ega tushirilgan, otkritkada odatiy.

tasks.en: Best wishes, Tom
tasks.note: 'Best wishes' — do'st va tanishlarga yoziladigan xayrlashuv.

exercises.instructionEn: Read postcard B (from Tracy in London).
exercises.instructionUz: B otkritkasini o'qing (Londondagi Treysidan).
exercises.explanationUz:
MANZIL:
  Mr & Mrs Johnson   — janob va xonim Jonson
  2 Via Torino       — ko'cha (italyancha nom)
  Rome               — Rim
  Italy              — Italiya

Demak, Treysi Londondan Rimdagi ota-onasiga yozyapti.

DIQQAT: 'Mr' (janob) va 'Mrs' (turmush qurgan xonim) —
dan keyin nuqta qo'yilmaydi (britancha).

tasks.en: Dear Mum and Dad,
tasks.note: Ota-onaga murojaat. Britanchada 'Mum', amerikachada 'Mom'.

tasks.en: Greetings from London.
tasks.note:
'Greetings from ...' — otkritkaning odatiy boshlanishi.
'a greeting' = salom, tabrik.

tasks.en: It's windy today and it is raining.
tasks.note: Ikki usul birga: SIFAT ('windy') va FE'L ('is raining').

tasks.en: The children are in their pyjamas in the living-room.
tasks.note:
KIYIM HAQIDAGI GAP — 7-mashqda tagiga chiziladi.
'pyjamas' DOIM ko'plikda (shim + ko'ylak).
'be IN + kiyim' = kiygan holda bo'lmoq.

tasks.en: They are very happy as they are decorating the Christmas tree at the moment.
tasks.uz: Ular juda xursand, chunki hozir Rojdestvo archasini bezashayapti.
tasks.note:
'as' bu yerda = 'because' (chunki).
'to decorate' = bezamoq.
'the Christmas tree' = Rojdestvo archasi (yangi yil archasi).

tasks.en: We miss you a lot.
tasks.note:

A MATNI — BRITANIYA (Karen)

tasks.uz: Britaniyada ob-havo ko'pincha yomg'irli, lekin qishda juda sovuq va shamolli ham bo'ladi.

tasks.uz: Yoz ancha iliq bo'lishi mumkin, lekin bulutli ham bo'lishi mumkin.

C MATNI — FINLANDIYA (Anita)

exercises.instructionEn: Present Continuous — affirmative and negative.
exercises.instructionUz: Present Continuous — tasdiq va inkor shakllari.
exercises.explanationUz:
PRESENT CONTINUOUS (hozirgi davomli zamon)

TASDIQ (Affirmative):
  I           AM     playing
  you         ARE    playing
  he/she/it   IS     playing
  we/you/they ARE    playing

INKOR (Negative):
  I           'M NOT  playing
  you         AREN'T  playing
  he/she/it   ISN'T   playing
  we/you/they AREN'T  playing

QOLIP: ega + to be + fe'l + ING

QACHON ISHLATILADI:
  HOZIR, gapirayotgan paytda sodir bo'layotgan ish uchun.

VAQT SO'ZLARI:
  now (hozir), at present (hozirda), at the moment (ayni paytda)

MISOLLAR:
  She's playing football now.
  She isn't eating an ice-cream at the moment.

O'ZBEKCHADA: '-yapti' qo'shimchasi bilan beriladi.
  She is playing → U o'ynayapti

tasks.en: Present Continuous — affirmative and negative.

tasks.en: I am playing. / I'm not playing.
tasks.note: 'I' bilan faqat AM. Inkori: I'm not ('I amn't' YO'Q so'z).

tasks.en: You are playing. / You aren't playing.
tasks.note: 'you' — birlikda ham, ko'plikda ham ARE.

tasks.en: He is playing. / He isn't playing.
tasks.note: he/she/it → IS. Qisqartma: He's playing.

tasks.en: She is playing. / She isn't playing.
tasks.note: 'isn't' = is not.

tasks.en: It is playing. / It isn't playing.
We are playing. / We aren't playing.
tasks.note: we/you/they → ARE. 'aren't' = are not.

tasks.en: They are playing. / They aren't playing.
She's playing football now.
tasks.note: Kitobdagi namuna. 'now' — Present Continuous belgisi.

tasks.en: She isn't eating an ice-cream at the moment.
tasks.note: Kitobdagi namuna. 'at the moment' — Present Continuous belgisi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the texts in Ex. 7 again and fill in the -ing form of the verbs in the table below, then complete the rules.
exercises.instructionUz: 7-mashqdagi matnlarni qayta o'qing va quyidagi jadvalga fe'llarning -ing shaklini yozing, so'ng qoidalarni to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
-ING QO'SHISHNING UCH QOIDASI:

  1) KO'PCHILIK FE'LLAR — shunchaki -ing qo'shiladi
       snow → snowing,  wear → wearing,
       rain → raining,  enjoy → enjoying

  2) BITTA URG'ULI UNLI + BITTA UNDOSH bilan tugasa —
     UNDOSH IKKILANADI
       swim → swiMMing,  run → ruNNing,  sit → siTTing
     Sabab: unli qisqa qolishi kerak.

  3) -E bilan tugasa — E TUSHADI
       make → makIng,  decorate → decoratIng,
       shine → shinIng,  write → writIng

DIQQAT: 'enjoy' -y bilan tugasa ham -ing oddiy qo'shiladi
(y dan oldin UNLI bor: enjOY).

tasks.whyUz:
1-qoida: oddiy -ing qo'shiladi.
49-betdagi A otkritkada: 'It is snowing heavily today.'

C otkritkada: 'enjoying the good weather'.

2-qoida: bitta urg'uli unli (i) + bitta undosh (m) → M IKKILANADI.
C otkritkada: 'Everyone is swimming'.

3-qoida: -E bilan tugaydi → E TUSHADI.
A va C otkritkalarda: 'making a snowman', 'making a sandcastle'.

3-qoida: -E TUSHADI.
B otkritkada: 'decorating the Christmas tree'.

3-qoida: -E TUSHADI.

exercises.explanationUz:
SO'ROQ SHAKLI (Interrogative):
  'be' fe'li EGADAN OLDIN chiqadi:
     Am I playing?    Are you playing?
     Is he playing?   Are they playing?

QISQA JAVOB QOIDASI:
  Yes, + ega + to'liq 'be' shakli.   (qisqartma YO'Q!)
  No,  + ega + qisqargan inkor shakli.

  TO'G'RI: Yes, I am.      XATO: Yes, I'm.
  TO'G'RI: No, I'm not.

JADVAL TO'LIQ HOLDA:
  Am I playing?      → Yes, I am.      / No, I'm not.
  Are you playing?   → Yes, you are.   / No, you aren't.
  Is he playing?     → Yes, he is.     / No, he isn't.
  Is she playing?    → Yes, she is.    / No, she isn't.
  Is it playing?     → Yes, it is.     / No, it isn't.
  Are we playing?    → Yes, we are.    / No, we aren't.
  Are you playing?   → Yes, you are.   / No, you aren't.
  Are they playing?  → Yes, they are.  / No, they aren't.

exercises.explanationUz:

  you're playing    Are you playing?       you aren't playing
  he's playing      Is he playing?         he isn't playing
  she's playing     Is she playing?        she isn't playing
  it's playing      Is it playing?         it isn't playing
  we're playing     Are we playing?        we aren't playing

  they're playing   Are they playing?      they aren't playing

UCH SHAKLNI SOLISHTIRING:
  TASDIQ:  ega + be + fe'l-ing
  SO'ROQ:  be + ega + fe'l-ing?   ('be' oldinga chiqadi)
  INKOR:   ega + be + NOT + fe'l-ing

faqat 'to be' o'zgaradi.

exercises.instructionEn: Form, Use and Spelling of the Present Continuous.
exercises.instructionUz: Present Continuous yasalishi, ishlatilishi va imlosi.
exercises.explanationUz:
YASALISHI (Form):
  'to be' fe'li + asosiy fe'lning asos shakli + -ING

ISHLATILISHI (Use):
  1) HOZIR, gapirayotgan paytda sodir bo'layotgan ish:
       I'm playing tennis now.
  2) Gapirish PAYTI ATROFIDA davom etayotgan ish:
       We're looking for a flat at the moment.
     (Aynan hozir qidirmayotgan bo'lishi ham mumkin,
      lekin bu kunlarda shu ish davom etyapti.)

VAQT IFODALARI:
  now (hozir), at the moment (ayni paytda),
  at present (hozirda)

IMLO (Spelling) — UCH QOIDA:
  1) Ko'pchilik fe'l: shunchaki -ing → look - looking
  2) Ikki undosh ORASIDAGI bitta urg'uli unli bo'lsa,
     oxirgi undosh IKKILANADI → run - running
  3) -e bilan tugasa, -e TUSHADI → take - taking

tasks.en: Form, Use and Spelling of the Present Continuous.
tasks.uz: Present Continuous yasalishi, ishlatilishi va imlosi.

tasks.en: We form the present continuous with the verb "to be" and add -ing to the base form of the main verb.
tasks.uz: Present Continuous 'to be' fe'li bilan yasaladi va asosiy fe'lning asos shakliga -ing qo'shiladi.
tasks.note: 'the base form' = asos shakl (lug'atdagi shakl).

tasks.en: We use the present continuous for actions happening now, at the moment of speaking. — I'm playing tennis now.
tasks.uz: Present Continuous hozir, gapirayotgan paytda sodir bo'layotgan ish uchun ishlatiladi. — Men hozir tennis o'ynayapman.
tasks.note: Bu — asosiy vazifasi.

tasks.en: We also use the present continuous for actions happening around the time of speaking. — We're looking for a flat at the moment.
tasks.uz: Present Continuous gapirish payti atrofida davom etayotgan ish uchun ham ishlatiladi. — Biz ayni paytda kvartira qidiryapmiz.
tasks.note:
Aynan shu daqiqada qidirmayotgan bo'lishi ham mumkin,
lekin bu davrda ish davom etyapti.

tasks.en: Time expressions used with the present continuous: now, at the moment, at present.
tasks.uz: Present Continuous bilan ishlatiladigan vaqt ifodalari: now, at the moment, at present.
tasks.note: Bu so'zlar gapda ko'rinsa — Present Continuous ishlatiladi.

tasks.en: Most verbs take -ing after the base form of the main verb. — look - looking
tasks.uz: Ko'pchilik fe'llar asos shakldan keyin -ing oladi. — look - looking
tasks.note: 1-imlo qoidasi.

tasks.en: Verbs ending in one stressed vowel between two consonants double the last consonant and take -ing. — run - running
tasks.uz: Ikki undosh orasida bitta urg'uli unli bilan tugagan fe'llar oxirgi undoshni ikkilantiradi. — run - running
tasks.note:
2-imlo qoidasi: r-U-n → running.
Boshqa misollar: swim - swimming, sit - sitting, stop - stopping.

tasks.en: Verbs ending in -e drop the -e and take -ing. — take - taking
tasks.uz: -e bilan tugagan fe'llar -e ni tashlab -ing oladi. — take - taking
tasks.note:
3-imlo qoidasi.
Boshqa misollar: make - making, shine - shining, write - writing.

exercises.instructionEn: Short answers.
exercises.instructionUz: Qisqa javoblar.
exercises.explanationUz:
QISQA JAVOBLAR JADVALI:

  Are you ...?   → Yes, I am.     / No, I'm not.
                   Yes, we are.   / No, we aren't.

  Is he/she/it ...? → Yes, he/she/it is.
                      No, he/she/it isn't.

  Are they ...?  → Yes, they are. / No, they aren't.

QOIDA:
  Qisqa javobda 'Yes' yoki 'No', EGA OLMOSHI va
  'to be' fe'lining to'g'ri shakli ishlatiladi.
  Asosiy fe'l (-ing bilan) TAKRORLANMAYDI.

  TO'G'RI: Is he playing? — Yes, he is.
  XATO:    Yes, he is playing.  (takrorlanmaydi)
  XATO:    Yes, he's.           (tasdiqda qisqartma yo'q)

DIQQAT — SAVOL 'YOU' BILAN BO'LSA:
  Javob 'I' yoki 'WE' bilan beriladi — kimga qaratilganiga qarab.

tasks.en: Short answers.
Are you playing? — Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
tasks.note: Bir kishiga qaratilgan savol → 'I' bilan javob.

tasks.en: Are you playing? — Yes, we are. / No, we aren't.
tasks.note: Bir necha kishiga qaratilgan savol → 'we' bilan javob.

tasks.en: Is he playing? — Yes, he is. / No, he isn't.
tasks.note: 'Yes, he's' XATO — tasdiq javobda qisqartma yo'q.

tasks.en: Is she playing? — Yes, she is. / No, she isn't.
Is it playing? — Yes, it is. / No, it isn't.
Are they playing? — Yes, they are. / No, they aren't.
In short answers we use "Yes" or "No", the subject pronoun and the verb "to be" in the correct form. We do not repeat the main verb with the -ing.
tasks.uz: Qisqa javobda 'Yes' yoki 'No', ega olmoshi va 'to be' fe'lining to'g'ri shakli ishlatiladi. Asosiy fe'l -ing bilan takrorlanmaydi.
tasks.note: 'a subject pronoun' = ega olmoshi (I, you, he, she, it, we, they).

exercises.instructionEn: Present Continuous vs Present Simple.
exercises.instructionUz: Present Continuous va Present Simple farqi.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI ZAMONNI SOLISHTIRISH — ENG MUHIM MAVZU

  PRESENT CONTINUOUS          PRESENT SIMPLE
  (be + fe'l-ing)             (fe'l / fe'l-s)

  HOZIR sodir bo'layotgan     ODAT va KUNDALIK tartib
  ish uchun:                  uchun:
    I'm studying now.           I go to work every day.

  Gapirish PAYTI ATROFIDA     DOIMIY holat uchun:
  davom etayotgan ish:          He lives in Manchester.
    He is working late
    these days.

VAQT SO'ZLARI BILAN FARQLASH:
  Present Continuous: now, at the moment, at present,
                      today, these days
  Present Simple:     every day, usually, always,
                      often, sometimes, never

MISOL — BIR FE'L, IKKI ZAMON:
  I'm studying now.        — hozir o'qiyapman (vaqtinchalik)
  I study every evening.   — har kuni kechqurun o'qiyman (odat)

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the present simple or present continuous.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni present simple yoki present continuous shakliga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
QAYSI ZAMONNI TANLASH — VAQT SO'ZIGA QARANG:

  PRESENT SIMPLE (odat, doimiy holat):
     usually, always, often, sometimes, never,
     every day / every Sunday / every afternoon,
     in her free time, in the summer

  PRESENT CONTINUOUS (hozir sodir bo'layotgan ish):
     now, at the moment, at present, today

PRESENT SIMPLE YASALISHI:
  I / you / we / they  → fe'l (asos shakli)

     oddiy:                wake up → wakes up
     -ch, -sh, -s, -x, -o: watch → watches;  go → goes
     undosh + y:           study → studies

PRESENT CONTINUOUS YASALISHI:
  ega + am/is/are + fe'l-ING

sentencePatterns.formula: Are YOU ...? — Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Are you listening to music? — Yes, I am.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Musiqa tinglayapsanmi? — Ha.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Savol sizga qaratilgan → javobda 'I' (yoki 'we').

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Jim usually wakes up late on Sundays. Joy watches TV every afternoon.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Jim odatda yakshanba kunlari kech uyg'onadi. Joy har kuni tushdan keyin televizor ko'radi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Odat va kundalik tartib → Present Simple.

sentencePatterns.formula: now / at the moment + Present Continuous
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: We are making a snowman at the moment. The children are swimming now.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Biz hozir qorbobo yasayapmiz. Bolalar hozir suzishayapti.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Hozir sodir bo'layotgan ish → Present Continuous.

sentencePatterns.formula: have a shower / have breakfast — HARAKAT, -ing mumkin.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Bill is having a shower at the moment.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bill hozir dush qabul qilyapti.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'have' EGALIK ma'nosida bo'lsa -ing OLMAYDI:
'I am having a car' XATO.
